claims.text: Pendry Manhattan West is a California-inspired hotel in Midtown Manhattan.

findings.quote: Pendry Manhattan West hotel is an understated, California-inspired Midtown destination

claims.text: The hotel is on Manhattan's west side, a 6-minute walk from Moynihan Train Hall and Penn Station and a 13-minute walk from the Javits Convention Center.

findings.quote: Pendry Manhattan West is located on Manhattan’s west side, a 6-minute walk from Moynihan Train Hall and Penn Station and a 13-minute walk from the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center.

claims.text: Guestroom interiors are by Gachot Studios.

findings.quote: each featuring warm, contemporary interiors by world-renowned Gachot Studios

claims.text: The suites have expansive space and skyline views of New York City.

findings.quote: feature upscale interiors by world-renowned Gachot Studios with expansive space and stunning skyline views of New York City.

claims.text: Every room has floor-to-ceiling windows.

findings.quote: Every room features floor-to-ceiling windows

claims.text: At nightly turndown, Billy Joel and Paul Simon music plays softly in the room.

findings.quote: Nightly turndown with soft slippers and bedside macarons includes a uniquely New York touch: you'll return to gentle Billy Joel and Paul Simon music softly filling both the living area and bedroom wing.

claims.text: The hotel has a 24/7 fitness center and Movement Studio with Technogym equipment and Peloton bikes.

findings.quote: Pendry Manhattan West features a 24/7, 1,700 square foot Fitness Center and Movement Studio featuring all-new Technogym equipment and Peloton bikes

claims.text: Zou Zou's is an Eastern Mediterranean restaurant led by Executive Chef Juliana Latif.

findings.quote: Zou Zou’s is an Eastern Mediterranean restaurant from some of the most notable culinary names in the city, helmed by Executive Chef Juliana Latif.

claims.text: Chez Zou, a cocktail lounge, has a fourth-floor terrace with open-air seating overlooking the plaza.

findings.quote: Chez Zou features a fourth-floor terrace patio with open-air seating overlooking the plaza.
Chez Zou, a cocktail lounge known for inventive drinks and small bites

claims.text: One-bedroom suites can adjoin deluxe king rooms, which suits groups or parents traveling with kids.

findings.quote: One-bedroom suites have the option to adjoin to adjacent deluxe king rooms, making them perfect for groups or parents traveling with kids.

claims.text: Dogs up to 60 pounds are welcome for an additional fee.

findings.quote: Yes. Pendry Manhattan West welcomes dogs up to 60 pounds for an additional fee.

claims.text: The surrounding Manhattan West area is an eight-acre, mixed-use development with shopping, a variety theater, a Whole Foods Market and restaurants.

findings.quote: The eight-acre, mixed-use area of Manhattan West boasts shiny new shopping venues, a variety theater, a Whole Foods Market, and restaurants by the likes of

claims.text: The facade is made of rippling waves of floor-to-ceiling glass, giving front-facing rooms semi-circle window nooks with panoramic city views.

findings.quote: The eye-catching structure is made up of rippling waves of floor-to-ceiling glass windows, giving the front-facing rooms semi-circle window nooks from which to take in the panoramic city views.

claims.text: The Pendry Suite is a 21st-floor, two-bedroom corner suite with a baby grand piano and a Bowers & Wilkins entertainment system.

findings.quote: the Pendry suite, a 21st-floor, two-bedroom corner suite with a baby grand piano and state-of-the-art entertainment system from Bowers & Wilkins

claims.text: The building was designed by Skidmore, Owings & Merrill, the firm behind the Freedom Tower and Moynihan Train Hall.

findings.quote: Pendry Manhattan West was designed by Skidmore, Owings & Merrill—the same firm behind the Freedom Tower and Penn Station’s new Moynihan Train Hall.

claims.text: Every room has been engineered to block out street noise.

findings.quote: Each and every room has been engineered to block out street noise

claims.text: Every suite has a standalone bathtub by the windows.

findings.quote: There are standalone bath tubs by the windows in every suite

claims.text: There is no spa on site; wellness centers on the fitness center and Movement Studio.

findings.quote: There's no spa on site
Pendry Manhattan West features a 24/7, 1,700 square foot Fitness Center and Movement Studio
findings.note: wellness page features fitness center and studio

claims.text: Rooms and suites look over either the city or Manhattan West Plaza, depending on the room, so ask about the view when booking.

findings.quote: Pendry Manhattan West guestrooms and suites offer views of the city or Manhattan West Plaza, depending on the room or suite selected.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
